n-k-l1f-03.title: Iorenji ezintathu, ishishini elilungileyo?
n-k-l1f-03.goal: Vavanya ibango lomthengi ngokuchasene nophawu lwexabiso, wahlule ixabiso lento nganye kwisiphumo, uze unike icebiso ngamanani.
n-k-l1f-03.material:
Kwisitali sesiqhamo, uJisu nomhlobo wakhe uMinsu bafunda uphawu:

[귤]
한 개: 1,000원
세 개: 2,500원

Jisu: 저는 귤 두 개만 필요해요.
Minsu: 세 개에 이천오백 원이에요! 싸요! 세 개 사요!
n-k-l1f-03.thinking.1: Ixabiso lento nganye vs ixabiso lilonke
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.prompt: Funda uphawu. Sisiphi isitetimenti uphawu oluxhasayo?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa ixabiso leeorenji ezintathu ezizodwa nexabiso lepakethe yeentathu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.1: Emva koko thelekisa izixa ezipheleleyo zenani elifanayo leeorenji.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.a: Iiorenji ezintathu zidla mncinci kune-orenji ezimbini.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.a: 3 iiorenji zidla i-2,500 won; 2 iiorenji zidla i-2,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.b: Iiorenji ezimbini ezivela kwixabiso elinye zidla ngaphezu kwepakethe yeentathu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.c: I-orenji nganye kwipakethe yeentathu idla ngaphantsi kwe-orenji enye.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.d: Ipakethe yeentathu idla ngaphezu kwee-orenji ezintathu ezizodwa.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 ezizodwa zidla i-3,000 won, hayi i-2,500 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.explain: Ipakethe idla i-2,500 won ngeentathu, malunga ne-833 won nganye, ngelixa enye idla i-1,000 won. Ngoko i-orenji nganye ikhuphisana ngexabiso kwipakethe, kodwa ipakethe idla ngaphezulu ngokupheleleyo kuneziwo ezimbini ezizodwa.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.prompt: UJisu udinga kuphela ii-orenji ezimbini ngomso. Ingaba icebiso likaMinsu '세 개 사요, 싸요!' lilungile ngeepokotho zakhe?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuba zingaphi ii-orenji ezifunwa nguJisu, uze ubale iindleko zenani elo kanye ngendlela nganye.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.1: Buza ukuba 'ngexabiso eliphantsi' kwisivakalisi sikaMinsu kuthetha ngecandelo okanye ngokupheleleyo.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.a: Ewe. I-orenji nganye ikhuphisana ngexabiso kwipakethe, ngoko ipakethe ingaphantsi kuye.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.a: Ukudla ngaphantsi ngecandelo akuthethi ukudla ngaphantsi ngokupheleleyo. Wayeya kuhlawula i-2,500 won, hayi i-2,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.b: Hayi. Ezimbini ezizodwa zidla i-2,000 won, kwaye ipakethe idla ngaphezulu.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.c: Ewe. I-2,500 won incinci kune-3,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.c: I-3,000 won lixabiso lezintathu ezizodwa, kodwa udinga kuphela ii-orenji ezimbini.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.d: Akunakugqitywa kuba uphawu alunalo ixabiso lee-orenji ezimbini.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.d: Ezimbini ezizodwa zidla 2 x 1,000 = 2,000 won; uphawu luyanela.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.explain: Kwii-orenji ezimbini, ezimbini ezizodwa (2,000 won) zingaphantsi kwepakethe (2,500 won). Ibango likaMinsu liyinyani ngecandelo, kodwa alihambelani noko uJisu akufunayo.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.prompt: Bhala izivakalisi ezi-1-2 zeengcebiso kuJisu (isiNgesi okanye isiKorea). Sebenzisa amanani asuka kuphawu njengobungqina.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.0: Yitsho oko uJisu akudingayo, uze unike isixa sendlela nganye yokuthenga.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Icebiso lam lihambelana nokuba uJisu udinga ii-orenji ezimbini?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.model.1: Kwii-orenji ezimbini, thenga ezimbini ezizodwa: 2,000 won. Ipakethe yeentathu yi-2,500 won, ngoko idla ngaphezulu nokuba i-orenji nganye ingaphantsi.

n-k-l1e-01.title: Igama, umsebenzi ... nelizwe?
n-k-l1e-01.goal: Phawula ukuba amakhadi amabini okuzazisa awaneli ngokufumana isibakala sombuzo, nqumela into engekhoyo, uze uyicele ngesiKorean.
n-k-l1e-01.material:
Usuku lokuqala lweklasi. Utitshala wakho unika amakhadi amabini okuzazisa (enziwe kolu msebenzi).

[카드 1]
안녕하세요? 저는 수진이에요. 학생이에요.

[카드 2]
안녕하세요? 저는 마이클이에요. 선생님이에요.

Utitshala ukhomba ikhadi 1 abuze: "수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?"
n-k-l1e-01.prereq.1: Uyazi 이름, 학생, 선생님, 사람 namagama amazwe
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.prompt: Utitshala wakho ubuza: '수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?' Usebenzisa amakhadi amabini kuphela, yeyiphi impendulo elungileyo?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuba isivakalisi ngasinye sekhadi 1 sikuxelela ntoni: igama, umsebenzi ... nayo nayiphi enye into?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Zibuze ukuba amakhadi aqulathe nawaphi na amagama elizwe okanye '-사람'.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.a: Ewe. 수진 ligama lesiKorean, ngoko uvela eKorea.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.a: Igama likhokelo, alingobungqina: abantu bamazwe amaninzi banamagama esiKorean, kwaye abantu baseKorea banamanye amagama. Khangela isivakalisi esibiza ilizwe.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.b: Hayi. 학생 ithetha ukuba ufunda phesheya, ngoko akangomKorean.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.b: 학생 ithetha 'umfundi' kuphela. Ayithethi nto ngalapho avela khona.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.c: Hayi okwangoku. Amakhadi anika igama nomsebenzi, kodwa hayi ilizwe.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.d: Hayi okwangoku. Ikhadi 1 alinalo igama, ngoko akukho mntu unokuthi.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.d: Igama likwikhadi: 수진. Isiqwengana esingekhoyo sesinye.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.explain: Ikhadi 1 linika igama (수진) nomsebenzi (학생) kodwa alinikanga ilizwe. Ikhadi 2 alinceda: lilandela 마이클. Impendulo 'ayaziwa okwangoku', kwaye ufuna isibakala esinye.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.prompt: Cinga 수진 wongeza ISIVAKALISI SINYE kwikhadi lakhe. Ziziphi izivakalisi ezongeziweyo ezinganqumela umbuzo katitshala? Khetha zonke ezinqumayo ('ewe' okanye 'hayi' zombini zibalwa).
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khangela izivakalisi ezibiza ilizwe lomntu, hayi into ayithandayo okanye afunda yona.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Vavanya isivakalisi ngasinye: emva kokusifunda, ungathi 'ewe' okanye 'hayi' ngokuqinisekileyo?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.r.a: Abantu abaninzi bamazwe amaninzi bafunda isiKorean, ngoko oku akuxeleli ilizwe lakhe.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.explain: Isivakalisi se-'-사람이에요' sibiza ilizwe. 호주 사람 iphendula 'hayi', 한국 사람 iphendula 'ewe'. Ukufunda isiKorean okanye ukuthanda ikofi akunqumi.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umbuzo wakho ku-수진 ngesiKorean (intetho ehloniphekileyo ye--요) ukufumanisa isibakala esingekhoyo.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuba sisiphi isibakala esingekhoyo, emva koko ubuze ngaso kuphela.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umbuzo wam ucela isibakala esingekhoyo (ilizwe) hayi oko amakhadi esele ekutsho?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uhloniphekile (-요) kwaye mfutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuphendulwa ngesivakalisi esinye?

n-k-l1e-02.title: Ithegi kaRina namazwi kaRina
n-k-l1e-02.goal: Hlola ukuzazisa ngokuthethwa ngokuchasene nethegi yegama, ufumane umgca omnye onesibakala esingalunganga, ubize uhlobo lwempazamo, uze uyilungise.
n-k-l1e-02.material:
URina ngumhlambuli. Unxiba ithegi yegama aze azazise eklasini.

[이름표]
이름: 리나
나라: 일본
직업: 선생님

Uthi imigca emihlanu engezantsi.
n-k-l1e-02.prereq.1: Uyazi 선생님, 학생, 일본 사람 kunye ne--이에요/예요
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.prompt: URina ufunda ngokuvakalayo ukuzazisa kwakhe. Thelekisa nethegi yegama lakhe. Ngqo umgca omnye awuhambelani nethegi. Ngowuphi?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.0: Eminye imigca ngumbuliso kwaye ayinazo izibakala. Phawula imigca equlathe izibakala.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thatha ithegi isibakala ngesibakala (igama, ilizwe, umsebenzi) ufumane umgca othi nganye.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca 4 uthi 학생이에요 ('ndingumfundi'), kodwa ithegi isithi 선생님 (utitshala). IsiKorean somgca 4 silungile ngokwegrama; isibakala asilunganga. Imigca 2 kunye no-3 iyahambelana nethegi, kwaye imigca 1 kunye no-5 ngumbuliso ongenazibakala.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Funda umgca ngokuvakalayo njengegrama kuphela: ngaba uphula nawuphi umthetho?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Emva koko thelekisa intsingiselo yawo, hayi ubume bawo, nethegi.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.o.a: Isigqibo esingalunganga: kufuneka sibe yi--예요, hayi -이에요.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.a: Isigqibo -이에요 silungile emva kwesilabhili esinonobumba wokugqibela (생). Isivakalisi silunge ngokwegrama.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.o.b: Igrama ilungile, kodwa isibakala asivumelani nethegi yegama.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.c: Isigqibo -요 sele sihloniphekile, ngoko umgangatho ulungile.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.d: 저는 ligama elihloniphekileyo elithi 'mna' kwaye lihambelana nodibaniso lokuqala; 나는 yayiza kuba yeyintetho engahloniphekanga.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.explain: Umgca unokuba yiKorean elungileyo kodwa ingalunganga kwimeko. Apha isivakalisi silungile, kodwa asihambelani nethegi.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kwakhona umgca ongalunganga ngesiKorean ukuze uhambelane nethegi yegama. Gcina intetho ehloniphekileyo ye--요.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.0: Faka igama elichanekileyo lomsebenzi elisuka kwithegi kwipatheni yesivakalisi esifanayo.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khangela isigqibo: ngaba igama lomsebenzi liphela ngoonobumba abangekho isikhamiso okanye isikhamiso?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umgca wam uthi umsebenzi okwithegi?

n-k-l1e-03.title: Igama elinye, imiboniso emithathu
n-k-l1e-03.goal: Funda igama elifanayo lesiKorean kwiindawo ezintathu ezikhulayo, uhlaziye intsingiselo yalo njengoko imeko itshintsha, uthi yintoni eyayigqibile, uze ulisebenzise ngokuchanekileyo.
n-k-l1e-03.material: Iindawo ezintathu ezimfutshane phakathi kwabafundi 하나 kunye 민수 (zenziwe). Basebenzisa intetho enentlonipho ye--요. Indawo nganye ibonakaliswa ngexesha elinye.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.prompt: Igama elifanayo livela kwiindawo ezintathu ezincinci. Funda indawo nganye ugqibe ukuba ithetha ntoni apho phambi kokuba ubone elandelayo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Phambi kokukhetha, funda umgca ongaphambi kwegama.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba omnye umntu usandula ukwenza ntoni: ubuzile, ubulele okanye wacela uxolo?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
Indawo 1. 하나 uzazisa umhlobo wakhe kuko 민수.

하나: 민수 씨, 이 사람은 지우 씨예요.
민수: 지우 씨는 선생님이에요?
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ekuphenduleni umbuzo othi ewe/hayi, 아니에요 ithetha 'hayi'.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akukho mntu umbulele, ngoko 'wamkelekile' akunasizathu sokuthethwa.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akukho mntu wenze impazamo kule ndawo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho nto ifuna ukuxolelwa apha; 민수 ubuzile umbuzo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.info:
Indawo 2. Kamva, 민수 uboleka 하나 usiba.

하나: 고마워요!
민수: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Emva kwe-고마워요, 아니에요 yimpendulo ethobekileyo: 'Akukho nto.' Igama elifanayo ngoku liphendula enkosi, hayi umbuzo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ubambe usiba. Oku kufunda igama ngendlela efanayo naseNdawo 1 kwaye kushiya oko 하나 asandula ukukuthetha.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.info:
Indawo 3. Kwindlela yangaphakathi 민수 uphazamisa ingalo ka-하나.

민수: 죄송해요!
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Emva koxolo, 아니에요 ithetha 'Kulungile, ungakhathazeki.' Igama elinye, imisebenzi emithathu: umgca ongaphambi kwalo ugqiba.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Akukho nto kule ndawo ithi uthandabuza yena; emva koxolo, igama linika intuthuzelo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.reflect: Ngaba ukufunda kwakho i-아니에요 kutshintshe kwindawo ngendawo? Wajonga ntoni ukugqiba ngalo lonke ixesha?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.prompt: Ukujonga emva kwiindawo ezintathu, yintoni egqibe intsingiselo ye-아니에요 ngalo lonke ixesha?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa oko kuhlale kunjalo nokutshintshileyo kwiindawo ezintathu.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga into eyayiza kwangoko phambi kwegama ngalo lonke ixesha.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.a: Igama laliyafana ngalo lonke ixesha, ngoko alinakuba sisona sitshintshe intsingiselo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.b: Umgca othethwe kwangoko phambi kwalo, noko kusandula kwenzeka.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.c: Amadoda nabafazi bayalisebenzisa igama kuzo zontathu iindlela.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.d: Esi sicelo simalunga nombhalo obhaliweyo; intsingiselo apha ivela kumagama angaphambili.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.explain: Igama alizange litshintshe. Intsingiselo yavela kumgca wangaphambili: umbuzo (hayi), enkosi (akukho nto) okanye uxolo (kulungile).
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.prompt: Umfundi ofunda naye uthi '고마워요!' kuwe kuba umboleke usiba. Phendula ngesiKorean (intetho enentlonipho ye--요) ngokuthobeka 'Akukho nto'.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ngomgca owubonileyo emva kwe-고마워요 kwindawo 2.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.1: Gcina isiphelo sinentlonipho (-요); impendulo emfutshane iyamkeleka.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba impendulo yam ithoba umoya wenceba endaweni yokuphinda enkosi?

n-k-l1e-04.title: Ngubani omncinci? Ukuthelekisa kuphela
n-k-l1e-04.goal: Guqula izazisi ezine eziqhelekileyo ezithelekisa iminyaka kuphela zibe ngumthetho, wakhe iiseti zeminyaka ezininzi ezisebenzayo, ubulise ngentlonipho ngenye, ufumane okuyinyani kuzo zonke.
n-k-l1e-04.material:
Abantu abane badibana eklasini yesiKorean (bonke benziwe). 민아 uthi iminyaka yakhe. Abanye bathelekisa kuphela.

민아: 저는 20살이에요.
하나: 저는 민아 씨보다 어려요. 지호 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
선생님: 저는 민아 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
(지호 akathi nto ngeminyaka.)

Amagama: 어려요 = mncinci (mncinci kunye); 나이가 많아요 = mdala; A보다 = kuno-A.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.prompt: UHana uthi: '저는 민아 씨보다 어려요.' Oko kukuxelela ntoni ngoHana?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana 보다 kwisivakalisi ubone ukuba idibanisa bani ababini.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba ikhona na inani kwisivakalisi sakhe.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.a: UHana uneminyaka eyi-19, ngoko mncinci ngonyaka omnye kuno-민아.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.a: Isivakalisi sithi 'mncinci' kodwa asinanombolo. I-19 yenye kuphela yeminyaka emininzi enokwenzeka.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.o.b: UHana mncinci kuno-민아; isivakalisi asinikeli nombolo.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.c: 어려요 ithetha 'mncinci'. -보다 ithetha 'kuno-', ngoko uHana mncinci, hayi mdala.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba baneminyaka efanayo, akukho mntu wayeya kuthi '어려요'.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.explain: '-보다 어려요' ibeka uthelekiso, hayi inani. Iminyaka emininzi iyahambelana.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.prompt: Wonke umntu eklasini uphakathi kwe-10 ne-60. 민아 uneminyaka engama-20. Yakha imizekelo eyahlukeneyo emi-3 (j = 지호, h = 하나, t = 선생님) apho yonke isivakalisi sisona, uze usebenzise iminyaka eyahlukileyo kuHana kwenye nenye.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.0: Beka abantu abane ngolandelelwano ukusuka kumncinci ukuya kumdala kuqala.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha iminyaka ka-하나, uze ukhethe 지호 omncinci no-선생님 omdala.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola isivakalisi ngasinye sesiKorean ngokuchasene namanani akho omnye emva komnye.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Akukho mntu eklasini ongaphantsi kwe-10 okanye ongaphezulu kwe-60.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c2: 하나 uthi mncinci kuno-민아, oneminyaka engama-20.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.fail.c4: 선생님 uthi mdala kuno-민아, oneminyaka engama-20.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.explain: Izivakalisi zinika uthelekiso kuphela, ngoko iminyaka emininzi iyahambelana: umzekelo 12 < 15 < 20 < 35. Nawaphi na amanani ngolandelelwano olululo ayasebenza.
n-k-l1e-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha omnye wemizekelo yakho. Bhala ngesiKorean oko 지호 akuthethayo xa edibana no-선생님 okokuqala: ukubulisa okunentlonipho neminyaka yakhe.

n-k-l1f-02.title: Iikopi ezintlanu zeofisi
n-k-l1f-02.goal: Guqula umyalezo omfutshane ube yimiqathango echanekileyo, ufumane imiyalelo emininzi eyanelisa yonke, uze uxele omnye ngesiKorea.
n-k-l1f-02.material:
Umhlobo wakho ukubhalela phambi kokuba uye kwikhefi:

"커피도 주스도 사 와요. 모두 다섯 잔이에요. 돈은 만 삼천 원 있어요."

Amagama: 커피도 주스도 = zombini ikofu nejusi (ezinye zazo zonke); 모두 = zizonke; 돈 = imali; 있어요 = unayo.

커피 한 잔: 3,000원
주스 한 잔: 2,000원

n-k-l1f-02.prereq.2: Uyazi 모두 kunye 커피도 주스도 (zichaziwe phantsi komyalezo)
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.prompt: '모두 다섯 잔이에요' ithetha ntoni kumyalezo womhlobo wakho?

n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.o.b: Iikopi ezintlanu zizonke, ikofu nejusi kunye
n-k-l1f-02.s.s1.explain: '모두' ithetha 'zizonke'. Iikopi zekofu neekopi zejusi kunye zintlanu.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.prompt: Fumana imiyalelo emi-3 eyahlukileyo ehambelana nayo yonke into kumyalezo. c = iikopi zekofu, j = iikopi zejusi.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha kuqala imiqathango ngamagama akho, umgca omnye ngamnye.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qala nge-c = 1 ufumane j ukuze iikopi zibe lilizonke; emva koko zama c = 2, njalo njalo.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola imali ekugqibeleni: 3,000 x c + 2,000 x j. Isaphakathi koko unako?
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 커피도 주스도: ubuncinane ikopi enye yenye nenye.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 모두 다섯 잔이에요: iikopi zongeza kanye kwiintlanu.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.explain: 1 ikofu + 4 jusi = 11,000 won; 2 + 3 = 12,000 won; 3 + 2 = 13,000 won. Zonke ziphakathi kwe-13,000 won. 4 ikofu + 1 jusi = 14,000 won kuninzi kakhulu. Imali ngumda, hayi ixabiso ekufuneka ulihlawule.
n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha OMNYE wemiyalelo yakho uthumele umhlobo wakho umyalezo ngesiKorea (-요 enembeko): iikopi ezingaphi zenye nenye ozityalelileyo kunye nexabiso lilonke.

n-k-l1g-01.title: Apha, apho, phaya: ndawo kabani?
n-k-l1g-01.goal: Sebenza ukuba 여기 no-거기 zikhomba kwindawo kabani, ubone ukuba kutheni isicatshulwa esine-여기 sinokushiya umfundi elahlekile, uze usibhale kwakhona ngegama lendawo lokwenyani.
n-k-l1g-01.material:
UMina noJun bahlobo. Emva kweklasi bafuna ukudibana, kodwa bakwiindawo ezahlukileyo. UMina uphambi kwesikolo (학교 앞). UJun uphambi kwethala leencwadi (도서관 앞). Bathetha ngefowuni.

민아: 준, 지금 어디예요?
준: 저는 도서관 앞이에요. 민아는요?
민아: 저는 학교 앞이에요.
준: 거기에서 기다려요. 제가 가요.
n-k-l1g-01.thinking.0: Igama elikhomba (apha/apho) lixhomekeke ekubeni ngubani othethayo nokuba ukuphi
n-k-l1g-01.thinking.1: Ukugqiba ukuba yeyiphi inyani elahlekileyo efunekayo ngokwenene
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.prompt: Kumgca wokugqibela ka-Jun, '거기에서 기다려요', 거기 ithetha yeyiphi indawo?
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.hint.0: Buza ukuba ngubani othethayo kunye nongubani omamelayo kuloo mgca.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.o.a: 도서관 앞, indawo apho uJun akhoyo
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.r.a: UJun wayeza kusebenzisa 여기 kwindawo yena ngokwakhe emi kuyo.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.o.b: 학교 앞, indawo apho uMina akhoyo
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.r.c: Indawo ekude nabantu bobabini yayiza kuba yi-저기. Apha uJun ukhomba kwindawo umphulaphuli ayibizileyo ngoku nje.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.o.d: Nayiphi na indawo; 거기 ayinantsingiselo imiselweyo
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.r.d: Intsingiselo ye-거기 ayimiselwanga, kodwa kwincoko nganye ikhomba kwindawo ethile: kufuphi nomphulaphuli.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s1.explain: 여기 ikufuphi nomthethi, 거기 ikufuphi nomphulaphuli (okanye indawo ebizwe ngumphulaphuli ngoku nje), kwaye 저기 ikude nabo bobabini. UJun uxelela uMina ukuba alinde apho esele ekhona: 학교 앞.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngosuku olulandelayo uMina uthumela uJun umyalezo wesicatshulwa: '준, 여기 카페에서 만나요.' UJun ukhaya kwaye akayazi ukuba lo 카페 uthetha ngayiphi. Yeyiphi inyani ENYE ayifunayo ukuze aqonde 여기?
n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.hint.0: Imbono kabani ethathwa yi-여기, eyombhali okanye eyomfundi?
n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ngesicatshulwa esifanayo sidluliselwa komnye umntu wesithathu. Kutshintsha ntoni?
n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.o.a: Apho uMina ebekhona xa ebhala isicatshulwa
n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.r.b: Ixesha alikuxeleli ukuba 여기 yeyiphi indawo.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.o.c: Apho uJun ema khona xa efunda isicatshulwa
n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.r.c: I-여기 yesicatshulwa ayikhombi kwindawo yomfundi; kwindawo yomfundi uMina wayeza kubhala 거기.

n-k-l1g-01.s.s2.explain: 여기 ithetha indawo yomntu ethethayo okanye obhalayo. Isicatshulwa asinasonwabo sokukhomba, ngoko umfundi kufuneka azi ukuba umbhali ebemi phi. Ukubiza indawo kuyakuphepha le ngxaki.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s3.prompt: UMina ukwikhefi ephambi kwesikolo (학교 앞 카페). Phinda ubhale isicatshulwa sakhe ngesiKorea (esinembeko -요) ukuze uJun afumane indawo naphi na afunda kuyo. Musa ukusebenzisa 여기, 거기 okanye 저기.

n-k-l1g-01.s.s3.hint.1: Gcina imo yesicatshulwa sikaMina: indawo + 에서 + isenzi esiphelela ku--요.
n-k-l1g-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba umntu ongamaziyo angayifumana ikhefi ngesicatshulwa sam sodwa?

n-k-l1g-02.title: Iposi ofisi ingumakhelwane kabani?
n-k-l1g-02.goal: Khangela indlela ebhaliweyo ngemephu, ufumane ukuba ziziphi imigca engahambelaniyo, uqonde oko 옆 ikuthethayo ngokwenene, uze ulungise umgca omnye.
n-k-l1g-02.material:
UMina ubhalela uJun indlela. Isitrato siya ngqo ukusuka esangweni lesikolo.
Icala langasekhohlo, ngolandelelwano ukusuka esangweni: 은행 (ibhanki), 편의점 (ivenkile yokulula), 우체국 (iposi ofisi).
Icala langasekunene, ngolandelelwano ukusuka esangweni: 병원 (isibhedlele), 약국 (ikhemesti), 카페 (ikhefi).

Imigca emithandathu kaMina ingezantsi. Eminye ayihambelani nemephu.
n-k-l1g-02.prereq.1: Uyazazi 왼쪽, 오른쪽, 옆, 에 있어요 namagama eendawo asemephini
n-k-l1g-02.s.s1.hint.0: Khangela imigca enye ngenye ngemephu: kuqala icala, emva koko ummelwane.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye one-옆, chaza abamelwane ababini balo ndawo kwicala layo lesitrato.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca 4 awulunganga: iposi ofisi ikufuphi ne-편의점, hayi kufuphi nebhanki (i-편의점 ikwindawo ephakathi kwazo). Umgca 5 awulunganga: isibhedlele sikwicala langasekunene. Imigca 1, 2, 3 no-6 iyahambelana nemephu.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi ngasinye fumana iindawo zombini kwimephu, uze ubale iindawo eziphakathi kwazo.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela nokuba icala lesitrato ndawo nganye ikuyo.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s2.r.a: Ikhemesti kunye nevenkile yokulula zikumacala achasene esitrato; 옆 ayiwelwa.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s2.r.b: Ikhemesti ikwindawo ephakathi kwesibhedlele nekhefi; 옆 ithetha indawo elandelayo ncam.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s2.r.d: Ivenkile yokulula ikwindawo ephakathi kwebhanki neposi ofisi; ukuba kwicala elifanayo akwanelanga ku-옆.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s2.explain: 옆 ithetha indawo elandelayo ncam kwicala elifanayo. Ikhemesti nekhefi ngabamelwane kwicala langasekunene.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale umgca 4 ngesiKorea ukuze uhambelane nemephu.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s3.hint.0: Jonga imephu: yeyiphi indawo ekufuphi ncam neposi ofisi?
n-k-l1g-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gcina imo yemigca eminye: indawo + 은/는 + indawo + 옆에 있어요.
n-k-l1g-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isivakalisi sam sibiza indawo ekufuphi ncam neposi ofisi?
n-k-l1g-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba sisaphela njengemigca kaMina eminye (…에 있어요)?

n-k-l1g-03.title: Amanqaku amathathu, izitrato ezingaphezu kwesinye
n-k-l1g-03.goal: Yakha ulungiselelo oluninzi oluhlukileyo lwesitrato ohambelana namanqaku amafutshane esiKorea, ubone ukuba amanqaku awagqibi impendulo enye.
n-k-l1g-03.material:
Isitrato esifutshane sinezithuba ezi-5 emgceni, ezibaliwe ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kwi-5 ukusuka kwisiphelo sangaseKHOHLO. I-은행 (ibhanki), i-병원 (isibhedlele) ne-약국 (ikhemesti) nganye imi kwisithuba esinye. Akukho zimbini ezabelana ngesithuba, kwaye izithuba ezimbini zihleli zingenanto. Amanqaku kaJun:

1. 병원은 은행 오른쪽에 있어요.
2. 약국은 병원 옆에 있어요.
3. 은행은 일 번이 아니에요.

(오른쪽 = ndawo ethile ngasekunene, hayi ngempela ecaleni kwayo.)
n-k-l1g-03.prereq.1: Uyawazi amanani eSino-Korea 일 ukuya ku-오, 번, 옆, 오른쪽
n-k-l1g-03.s.s1.prompt: Ungakhathali ibhanki okwesiqendu. I-병원 ikwisithuba 4. Ngenqaku 2, i-약국 inokuba phi?
n-k-l1g-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba izithuba ezintlanu emgceni uphawule isithuba 4. Jonga izithuba ezilichukumisayo.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funda inqaku 2 kwakhona ukhangele ukuba lichaza icala na.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s1.r.a: 옆 ithetha nokuba nguwuphi umakhelwane, ekhohlo okanye ekunene.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s1.r.c: 옆 ithetha nokuba nguwuphi umakhelwane, ekhohlo okanye ekunene.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s1.r.b: Isithuba 2 sikumanyathelo amabini; 옆 ithetha isithuba esilandelayo ncam.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s1.explain: 옆 ithetha isithuba esilandelayo, kwicala nelicala: isithuba 3 okanye isithuba 5.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ulungiselelo olu-3 olwahlukileyo oluhambelana namanqaku onke amathathu. b = isithuba se-은행, h = isithuba se-병원, p = isithuba se-약국.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngenqaku 3 nenqaku 1: khetha isithuba sebhanki, emva koko isithuba ngasekunene sayo sesibhedlele.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.hint.1: Emva koko beka ikhemesti ecaleni kwesibhedlele kwisithuba esikhululekileyo.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.hint.2: Khangela inqaku ngalinye enye ngenye kumgca wakho.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.ok.c0: Zonke izithuba zikumbindi we-1 kunye ne-5.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Isithuba ngasinye kufuneka sibe yinani eliphelele ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-5.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Inqaku 1: 병원 kufuneka ibe ngasekunene kwe-은행, ngoko inani layo likhulu.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Inqaku 2: 약국 kufuneka ibe kwisithuba esikufuphi ncam ne-병원.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo: ibhanki 2, isibhedlele 3, ikhemesti 4; okanye ibhanki 2, isibhedlele 4, ikhemesti 5; okanye ibhanki 3, isibhedlele 5, ikhemesti 4. Kukho ulungiselelo olu-6 zizonke. Amanqaku anika imida, hayi isitrato esinye esichanekileyo.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Thatha ULUNGISELELO LUNYE lwakho. Bhala isivakalisi esinye sesiKorea (esinembeko -요) esithi i-약국 ikuphi, usebenzisa 옆.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Jonga umgca wakho: yeyiphi indawo emi ecaleni kwe-약국 ncam?
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sebenzisa ipatheni: indawo + 은/는 + indawo + 옆에 있어요.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isivakalisi sam sihambelana nomgca endiwakhileyo?
n-k-l1g-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndibize ummelwane wokwenene we-약국 kumgca wam?
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.prompt: Umhlobo kaJun ujonga kuphela umgca wibhanki 2, isibhedlele 3, ikhemesti 4 aze athi: 'Ngoko i-약국 kufuneka ibe kwisithuba 4.' Yintoni eyinyani ngamanqaku amathathu?
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.hint.0: Jonga imigca oyakhileyo: ingaba zonke zinayo i-약국 kwisithuba esifanayo?
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.hint.1: Isibhengezo esine-'kufuneka' sifuna ukuba yinyani kuyo yonke imigca ehambelanayo.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.o.a: Amanqaku ahambelana nomgca omnye kuphela, ngoko i-약국 ikwisithuba 4.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.r.a: Amanqaku ahambelana nemigca emi-6. Isithuba 4 sesinye kuphela seendawo ezinokwenzeka.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.o.b: Amanqaku ahambelana nemigca emininzi, kodwa i-약국 kufuneka ihlale ikufuphi ne-은행.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.r.b: Imigca emibini kuphela kwemithandathu ineyi-약국 ikufuphi ne-은행; akukho nqaku lithi oko.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.o.c: Amanqaku ahambelana nemigca emininzi, kwaye i-약국 inokuba kwisithuba 3, 4 okanye 5.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.o.d: Amanqaku ahambelana nemigca emininzi, kodwa i-약국 inokuba kwisithuba 3 okanye 4 kuphela.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.r.d: Isithuba 5 siyasebenza nasiso, umzekelo ibhanki 2, isibhedlele 4, ikhemesti 5.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.o.e: Amanqaku ahambelana nemigca emininzi, kodwa i-약국 kufuneka ihlale kwisithuba 5.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.r.e: Eminye imiqolo ine-약국 kwindawo yesi-3 okanye yesi-4, ngoko ayihlali ikwindawo yesi-5.
n-k-l1g-03.s.s3.explain: Amanowuthi ahambelana nemiqolo emithandathu kwaye ikhemesti ikwindawo yesi-3 kumqolo omnye, kwindawo yesi-4 kwimiqolo emi-3 nakwindawo yesi-5 kwimiqolo emi-2. Umzekelo omnye awusoze wanele ukuthi yintoni emele ibe yinyani.

n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela imigca oyifundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-l1g-04.title: Ngaba sele bekwindawo enye?
n-k-l1g-04.topic: Ukubuza indlela: isitishi sikaloliwe esingaphantsi komhlaba neendlela zokuphuma
n-k-l1g-04.goal: Hlaziya isigqibo sakho malunga nokuba abahlobo ababini bakwindawo enye njengoko iinkcukacha ezingakumbi zifika, uze ubhale umyalezo ophelisa lo mba.
n-k-l1g-04.material: UHana noJun baza kudibana kwikaloliwe engaphantsi komhlaba. Bathetha ngefowuni. Funda icandelo ngalinye ugqibe ukuba ungathini ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-l1g-04.thinking.0: Ukuba igama lendawo likubanga kangakanani ngokwenene
n-k-l1g-04.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya isigqibo xa ulwazi olutsha lufika
n-k-l1g-04.prereq.1: Uyazi 역, 출구, amanani eSino-Korean 일 ukuya ku-오
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda icandelo ngalinye ukhethe ukufunda okunengqiqo kakhulu ngapho bakhona.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.hint.1: Zibuze: ingaba kusekho indawo engaphezulu kwenye efanelana nezivakalisi zombini?
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.0.after: '역' ithi uhlobo lwendawo kuphela. Ngaphandle kwegama, asikwazi ukwazi ukuba sisitishi esifanayo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ngamnye uthe kuphela 역 (isitishi). Zininzi izitishi esixekweni.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hayi. Bathe igama elifanayo, ngoko kufuneka babe kwizitishi ezahlukeneyo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Igama elifanayo alibonisi izitishi ezahlukeneyo; imigca ayithi nje ukuba sesiphi isitishi.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mhlawumbi. Bobabini bathe 역, kodwa zininzi izitishi.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ewe. UHana uthe 저도, ngoko ukwisitishi sikaJun.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Isitishi siyafana, kodwa isitishi esikhulu sinendlela ezininzi zokuphuma. Indawo echanekileyo isavulekile.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Basesitishini esinye, kodwa asikwazi okwangoku ukuthi bamile kwindawo enye.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Basemigceni eyahlukileyo, ngoko kufuneka babe kude (oku akuhambelani nolwazi).
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Bobabini bathe 시청역. Akukho nto apha ebonisa izitishi ezahlukeneyo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Isitishi sinokuba sikhulu sinendlela ezininzi zokuphuma; isitishi esifanayo asikafani nendawo efanayo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Asikwazi nto okwangoku, kuba 시청역 inokuba naphi.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Igama lesitishi 시청역 liyasimisa isitishi; okusavulekileyo yindawo ngaphakathi kwaso.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Zombini izivakalisi ziyinyani ngaxeshanye: isitishi esinye, iindlela ezimbini zokuphuma. Basenokukhetha indlela enye yokuphuma.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Indlela yokuphuma 1 neyokuphuma 2 zinokuba kude kwisitrato.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Bobabini bathe 시청역; iindlela zokuphuma kuphela eziyahluka.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Bakwindlela efanayo yokuphuma; 일 no-이 ziyavakala ziyafana.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 일 (1) no-이 (2) ngamanani ahlukeneyo, ngoko bathe iindlela zokuphuma ezahlukeneyo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Isitishi esifanayo, kodwa kwiindlela zokuphuma ezahlukeneyo. Abakabi kwindawo enye.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s1.reflect: Igama lendawo linokufanelana neendawo ezininzi ekuqaleni. Inkcukacha nganye entsha (igama lesitishi, emva koko indlela yokuphuma) yenza indawo ibe ncinci. Ukudibana kusebenza kuphela xa inkcukacha ichanekile ngokwaneleyo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku uHana noJun kufuneka badibane. Ngubani omele ahambe aye kwindlela yokuphuma yomnye umntu?
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ngaba kukho umthetho othi omnye wabo kufuneka afuduke?
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.hint.1: Yintoni eyayiya kubenza bobabini baphele kwindlela yokuphuma efanayo?
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.o.a: Nawuphi na; kufuneka bavumelane kwindlela enye yokuphuma
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.o.c: Akukho namnye, kuba basesitishini esinye kwaye sele bebonana
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.r.c: Isitishi esikhulu sinendlela ezininzi zokuphuma; isitishi esifanayo asisiyo indawo efanayo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.o.d: Bobabini kufuneka bahlale apho bakhona balinde
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.r.d: Ukuba bobabini balinde kwiindlela zokuphuma ezahlukeneyo, abasoze badibane.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s2.explain: Nawuphi na unokuhamba, okanye bobabini bangaya kwindlela yokuphuma yesithathu. Okubalulekileyo kukuba babize indlela enye yokuphuma bavumelane ngayo.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umyalezo olandelayo kaJun ngesiKorean (i--요 enentlonipho) ukuze badibane. Biza indlela enye yokuphuma.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha enye yeendlela zokuphuma ezimbini ubeke inani layo endaweni yokudibana.
n-k-l1g-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umyalezo wam unika indlela enye yokuphuma kuphela?
n-k-l1g-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uHana wayeya kwazi ngqo apho emi khona?

월~금  06:00 ~ 22:00
토  08:00 ~ 20:00
일  없어요

(월~금 = ukusuka eMvulo ukuya kuLwesihlanu.) Abahlobo abane bathetha ngebhasi 10.

n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.prompt: NguMgqibelo, 7:00 ekuseni (아침 일곱 시). UJun ufuna ukuthatha ibhasi 10 aye esibhedlele. Kufuneka enze ntoni?

n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.r.a: 06:00 lixesha lokuqala leentsuku zeveki. UMgqibelo unamaxesha awo.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.o.b: Sebenzisa enye indlela, kuba akukho bhasi namhlanje
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.o.c: Linda ukuya kuMvulo, kuba iibhasi aziqhubi ngeempelaveki

UMinsu wabhala ngeveki yakhe kwiklasi yakhe yesiKorean. Umfundi ofunda naye uSora wayifunda wenza ibango.

n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.prompt: Suah uthi '여섯 시에는 집에 가요.' Ixesha lokufunda ziiyure ezimbini. Lelona xesha lokuqala LIKHONA elisebenzayo?
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bala iiyure ezimbini phambili ukusuka kwixesha lokuqala elinokwenzeka.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ixesha lokufunda kufuneka ligqitywe xa eshiya.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba uqala ngentsimbi yesihlanu, ufunda ukuya kwesixhenxe. USuah sele ebuyile ekhaya ngentsimbi yesithandathu.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.r.c: Intsimbi yesithathu lelona xesha lokuqala anokuza ngalo, hayi lelokugqibela. Ixesha lokuqala elilandelayo lisenokusebenza.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.r.d: Ukuqala ngentsimbi yesithandathu kukwangoko emva kokuba eshiyile.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s1.explain: Iiyure ezimbini ukusuka kwesine ziphela ngentsimbi yesithandathu, kanye xa ebuya ekhaya. Ixesha lokuqala elandelayo lingaphela emva kwesithandathu.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ukhetho OLWAHLUKILEYO lwama-3 (usuku nexesha lokuqala) olungahambelana nabahlobo abane bonke. d = usuku (1 = uMvulo, 2 = uLwesibini, 3 = uLwesithathu, 4 = uLwesine, 5 = uLwesihlanu, 6 = uMgqibelo, 7 = iCawa). h = iyure yokuqala emva kwemini (3 = 오후 세 시).
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala usike iintsuku ezipheleleyo, emva koko uphathe iiyure.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ayingomhlobo ngamnye isivakalisi sakhe esifuna ukutshintsha impendulo yakho: buza ukuba sichaphazela emva kwemini na.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.hint.2: Ezinye iintsuku zinomda ngamaxesha athile kuphela. Kusuku ngalunye olungasikwanga, hlola iiyure zakho ezimbini ngokuchasene nawo onke amathuba.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.ok.c0: Usuku lokwenyani neyure epheleleyo yasemva kwemini.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa inani losuku ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7 neyure epheleleyo yasemva kwemini.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Iiyure ezimbini kufuneka ziphele ngentsimbi yesithandathu, xa 수아 ebuyela ekhaya.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.fail.c5: NgoLwesithathu 유나 unevenkile yeklasi ngentsimbi yesine, ongqubana neeyure zakho ezimbini.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.explain: Iintsuku ezinokwenzeka: uLwesibini, uLwesine, uMgqibelo (uMvulo noLwesihlanu azikho, iCawa ayikho, uLwesithathu lungqubana neklasi). Amaxesha okuqala anokwenzeka: ntsimbi yesithathu okanye yesine. Ukudada kukaJia kusasa ngoMgqibelo akubalulekanga kuba intlanganiso ingemva kwemini. Oko kunika ukhetho olusithandathu; nawaphi amathathu alungile.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha ELINYE kukhetho lwakho ubhalele iqela icebo ngesiKorean, linosuku, i-오후 neyure.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa umgca omnye kuluhlu lwakho: yiyiphi imini, yiyiphi iyure?
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ipatheni: usuku + 오후 + iyure + 시에 만나요.
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usuku lwam lunye lwaLwesibini, Lwesine okanye uMgqibelo?
n-k-l1h-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba iyure yam yesithathu okanye yesine emva kwemini?

n-k-l1e-05.title: Ukuzazisa ongaqondiyo anokukusebenzisa
n-k-l1e-05.goal: Bhala ukuzazisa kwezivakalisi ezintathu komntu onikiweyo, ukhethe ifom echanekileyo ye-'ukuba' emva kwegama ngalinye, uphendule ukubulisa ngokufanayo.
n-k-l1e-05.material:
Udlala u-벤 (umntu owenziweyo) kwiklasi yakho yokuqala yesiKorean. Nantsi ikhadi lakhe.

[카드]
이름: 벤
나라: 호주
직업: 의사

Utitshala mdala kunawe.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s1.prompt: Igama lakho ngu-벤 (liphela ngekonsonanti, ㄴ). Uthi njani 'Ndinguben'?
n-k-l1e-05.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga isandi sokugqibela se-벤: siphela ngesikhamiso okanye ngekonsonanti?
n-k-l1e-05.s.s1.hint.1: Khumbula iifom ezimbini ze-'ukuba': enye emva kwesikhamiso, enye emva kwekonsonanti.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s1.r.a: -예요 ilandela isilabhili esiphela ngesikhamiso (umz. 안나예요). 벤 iphela ngekonsonanti.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s1.r.c: -이예요 yimpazamo eqhelekileyo yokupela. Iifom ezichanekileyo ziyi--이에요 ne--예요.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s1.explain: Emva kwekonsonanti yokugqibela sebenzisa -이에요 (벤이에요, 사람이에요); emva kwesikhamiso sebenzisa -예요 (의사예요, 안나예요).
n-k-l1e-05.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ukuzazisa kwakho ngesiKorean kulo mntu owenziweyo: 이름 벤 / 나라 호주 / 직업 의사. Bulisa kuqala, emva koko unike igama, ilizwe nomsebenzi kwizivakalisi ezi-3 ezimfutshane. Sebenzisa intetho enentlonipho.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubulisa okwaziyo, emva koko wongeze inyani enye kwisivakalisi ngasinye.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola igama ngalinye phambi kwe--이에요/예요: liphela ngekonsonanti okanye ngesikhamiso?
n-k-l1e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umbhalo wam unika igama, ilizwe nomsebenzi?
n-k-l1e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndikhethe 이에요 okanye 예요 ngokuchanekileyo emva kwegama ngalinye?
n-k-l1e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba umntu ongamaziyo wayenokuqonda ukuba ndingubani ngawo?
n-k-l1e-05.s.s3.prompt: Emva kokuzazisa kwakho, utitshala uthi '만나서 반가워요.' Phendula ngesiKorean (intetho enentlonipho). Bonisa ukuba uvakalelwa ngokufanayo.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s3.hint.0: Funda oko utitshala akuthethayo: uchaza imvakalelo enjani?
n-k-l1e-05.s.s3.hint.1: Phendula ukuze utitshala eve ukuba uvakalelwa ngokufanayo, ngentetho enentlonipho.
n-k-l1e-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba impendulo yam ibonisa imvakalelo katitshala?
